scope_note: Local research prototype policy. Not a bank, regulatory or production approval policy.

dataset.on_hash_mismatch: refuse: a different file is a different study and needs a new policy version

split.temporal_note: Cross-sectional sample; row order is not chronological. No out-of-time claim is possible.

features.demographic_policy_note: Default excludes demographics from predictors; they are used only for audit slices. Setting true changes the study identity.
features.undocumented_code_treatment: PAY_* codes -2 and 0 kept as distinct codes; EDUCATION {0,5,6} and MARRIAGE {0} grouped as 'undocumented_code' only where demographics are used

models.class_weighting: none (resampling/weighting distorts predicted probabilities; not used)
models.hyperparameter_selection: lowest mean log loss in 5-fold stratified CV inside the train partition only

calibration.selection_rule: For each model, use sigmoid unless it increases log loss on the tuning partition relative to the uncalibrated model; then use none.
calibration.isotonic: not used in v1: only 3000 calibration rows and no separate partition to select it without bias

champion_selection.rule: Select the challenger only if the upper bound of the paired 95% bootstrap CI for (challenger log loss - baseline log loss) on the tuning partition is below 0; otherwise retain the interpretable baseline.

threshold.rationale: On calibrated probabilities 0.5 means 'default judged more likely than not'. Illustrative for reporting only; not an operational lending cut-off. A cost-based threshold c_fp/(c_fp+c_fn) is available as a user-supplied scenario.

uncertainty.method: paired nonparametric percentile bootstrap over customers (same resampled rows for both models)
uncertainty.conditional_on: fitted models and the evaluation sample; excludes training-sample uncertainty

slices.support_note: Review warnings, not universal statistical cut-offs.
slices.credit_limit_bands: quartiles of LIMIT_BAL fitted on the train partition
slices.repayment_groups: PAY_0 grouped: <=0 (no delay code), 1, >=2; and count of delayed months (PAY_* >= 1) in six months: 0, 1-2, 3+
slices.language: Descriptive audit only; no legal fairness determination; no multiplicity correction.

stress.scenarios: see app/stress.py SCENARIOS; seeded, documented perturbations

drift.note: Configurable review triggers, not regulatory limits.

review_checks.slice_auc_gap_note: Slices whose AUC CI lies wholly below overall AUC are flagged for review.

final_holdout_rule: Evaluate once, only after the selection record is frozen, with explicit confirmation. Results are an audit; they are never used to change models, thresholds, calibration or criteria.
release_approval: explicit_human_research_review; deterministic checks flag concerns but never accept a model
